description.value: Finn Slough is a tidal heritage community on the Fraser River in Richmond, BC, managed by the Finn Slough Heritage & Wetland Society. It is tagged as a tourism attraction in OpenStreetMap, suggesting it is a publicly accessible site of cultural or natural interest. Cyclists riding the Richmond dyke trail network may find it a worthwhile stop along the river.
